news.title: White House to speak with law enforcement groups to push Crypto's Clarity Act
news.summary: Officials from the White House are said to be sitting down with law enforcement representatives who have objected to illicit-finance portions of the bill.

news.title: Private keys, not smart contracts, caused 40% of crypto's $16 billion hack losses. Here's whats being done.
news.summary: The industry is moving toward fixing the private key vulnerability issue, just not evenly, Wish Wu, co-founder and CEO of Pharos, said.

news.title: JPMorgan urges strong safeguards as congress weighs crypto market structure rules
news.summary: The bank says Congress should pair regulatory clarity with safeguards as Senate negotiates the Clarity Act.

news.title: Bitcoin lending is entering a new institutional era, according to Silicon Valley Bank
news.summary: The bank said bitcoin lending has emerged from the 2022 crypto credit collapse with stronger risk controls, growing institutional participation and a path toward lower borrowing costs.

news.title: Bitcoin under pressure below $60,000 as Japanese yen hits 40-year low against the U.S. dollar
news.summary: BTC fell in Asia as the Japanese yen tanked to four-decade lows, lifting the dollar higher across the board.

news.title: Ether, solana and dogecoin slide as Strategy's bitcoin sales plan pressures market
news.summary: Bitcoin held below $60,000 as a surging dollar kept crypto pinned. Onchain demand stayed quiet through the week's losses, and Strategy's plan to possibly sell bitcoin added to the caution.

news.title: Dubai set for crypto firm influx as MiCA deadline pushes companies to reassess Europe
news.summary: Dubai lawyer Irina Heaver says European founders are flocking to the UAE for faster licensing, a dedicated crypto regulator and access to markets beyond Europe.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
